title: I made Damned Dice, a PS1 classic inspired puzzle game. Find the Demo on Itch.
author: Admirable_Phase_8576
selftext:
**Play it free in your browser:** [https://mysticscottie.itch.io/damned-dice](https://mysticscottie.itch.io/damned-dice)



I've always tried to make games. Over the years I learned bits of coding from Udemy, YouTube and Humble Bundles. Then came vibe coding.

I've been experimenting with a few games, and this is probably the most polished one I've made so far.

**The game**

Damned Dice is a real-time dice puzzler inspired by the PS1 classic Devil Dice. You play a little devil walking across the dice and rolling them around the floor.

* **Match:** line up connected dice showing the same number. Once there are as many as the number, they sink: two 2s, three 3s, up to six 6s.
* **Chain:** roll another matching die into a sinking group to build your score.
* **Happy One:** roll a 1 into a sinking group and every resting 1 on the board goes down with it.

The demo has 12 lessons that teach one idea at a time, special dice and curses, and a three-minute Daily Rush on the same board for everyone.

**How it was made**

It's all AI-supported, using various models that I used to polish and  have the AI's check each other's work. The majority of the code is Claude, checked by Gemini and GPT. The art is all Nano Banana Pro, and the audio is Web Audio.

I'd love your feedback. 

Any bugs, does it make sense, hows it playing etc.. :)
